heading: Zakat Calculator
summary: Zakat Calculator is being prepared and does not calculate anything yet. When it opens, it will work out zakat step by step: you enter your assets and debts, choose a labelled option wherever scholars differ, and see the result with the method and sources behind each step. It will not give a single ruling.
steps: Enter your cash, gold, silver, business stock and debts, using the prices you use for the day.
Choose the labelled option for each point where scholars differ. No option is selected for you.
Read the calculation, the method and the sources for each choice before you act on it.

questions.question: Does this calculator give a ruling?
questions.answer: No. It is planned to show the calculation for the choices you make, with each choice labelled and sourced. It is not a fatwa. For your own situation, ask a scholar or your local zakat committee you trust.

questions.question: Can I use it for my zakat now?
questions.answer: Not yet. This version only introduces the app. Its method and sources are still being verified, and they will be shown in full before the calculator opens.
